贈尚書令 is the Director of State Affairs.
Zhouhan married the Last Emperor’s daughter, the Princess of Shouchun; Zhou Jing married his sister, the Princess of Jin’an.
Zhouhan married the Last Emperor’s daughter, the Princess of Shouchun; Zhou Jing married another of the Last Emperor's daughters, the Princess of Jin’an.
亦娶末帝女 is another daughter of the Last Emperor.
In Ganfu 6 he was appointed military commissioner of Yiwu.
In Qianfu 6 he was appointed military commissioner of Yiwu.
In the sixth year of Ganfu he was at once appointed military commissioner of the Yiwu army.
In the sixth year of Qianfu he was at once appointed military commissioner of the Yiwu army.
乾符 reads Qianfu, not Ganfu.

Abaoji invaded with the whole Khitan nation. Ding wanted no part of it. A clerk named He Zhaoxun urged Du to strike. Du seized Chuzhi, locked him in the west hall, declared himself acting commissioner, and butchered nearly every Wang and every loyal officer.

Abaoji invaded with the whole Khitan nation. Ding wanted no part of it. A clerk named He Zhaoxun urged Du to strike. Du seized Chuzhi, locked him in the west hall, declared himself acting commissioner, and butchered nearly every Wang and every one of Chuzhi's officers.
處直將校 are Chuzhi's officers; the text does not call them loyal.
Hongshou answered: “Zhongshan favored me for two reigns. I could not betray it.”
Hongshou answered: “Zhongshan has favored my family for two generations. I could not betray it.”
兩世 means two generations, not two reigns.

Learning that Jin had stripped its home garrisons and plunged deep into Liang, Shouguang mustered his army, tightened discipline, and sent envoys to Zhen and Ding: “Yan can field three hundred thousand picked men. I will march with your two circuits in Jin’s wake—but who leads this alliance?”
三十萬 is three hundred thousand.

Shouguang heard Jin had emptied its state and penetrated deep into Liang; then he drilled troops and set strict guard, and sent someone with words to move Zhen and Ding: “Yan has thirty thousand elite troops. I shall lead the two circuits to follow Jin—yet who shall head this alliance?”

Jin did rescue Zhao, crushing Liang at Boxiang, then raiding through Xing and Mo as far as Liyang.
Jin did rescue Zhao, crushing Liang at Baixiang, then raiding through Xing and Ming as far as Liyang.
柏鄉 is Baixiang, and 洺 is Ming, not Mo.
The Prince of Jin indeed rescued Zhao, greatly defeated Liang at Boxiang, advanced to plunder Xing and Mo, and reached Liyang.
The Prince of Jin indeed rescued Zhao, greatly defeated Liang at Baixiang, advanced to plunder Xing and Ming, and reached Liyang.
柏鄉 is Baixiang; 洺 is Ming.

The Prince summoned Xiaoxi. Xiaoxi glared: “You jailed your father, killed your brother, violated your own kin—did I teach you that?”
蒸其骨肉 here means incest with kin (his father's concubine), not cooking flesh.

蒸 is 烝, illicit relations within the family.

At Taiyuan the Prince had Rengong and his son dragged forward in ropes and presented at the ancestral temple.
仁恭父子 means Rengong and his son.
乃俱死 does not count three or say how they died.

unresolvedReferences.description: Title mismatch: the Chinese title reads 雜傳第二十七 but the English says Miscellaneous Biographies 19. Units s0001-s0039 write 镕 and s0271-s0277 write 鎔; both are kept as written.
The text says five men over four generations ruled Chengde, but s0002 lists six descendants; Shaoyi's governorship is external.
The age of ten is not turned into a birth year.
Units s0271-s0277 are out of sequence in the packet and are treated as written. Jingfu 1 = 892 is external.
晉王 is identified as Li Keyong externally.
五世六公 is repaired to five generations and six lords.
The grandmother's funeral is undated; it is set by 是時 at Luo Shaowei's death.
The idiomatic reversed the father's-friend relation; repaired.
晉王 in 921 is identified externally as Li Cunxu (Zhuangzong) but is kept as a separate title record.
Zhaohui's age of ten is not turned into a birth year.
Rang is Shaowei's grandfather and presumably Hongxin's father; only the stated grandfather link is claimed.
Luoluo's father, the Prince of Jin, is identified externally as Li Keyong.
倍年之長 is repaired to a generation senior.
The chapter says the guard had lasted two hundred years by Shaowei's time, but external chronology from Tian Chengsi (763) to 905 gives about 140; kept as written and not used for dating.
The Liang princess who died is not named; she may be one of the two princesses in s0124 and has a separate record.
Shaowei died at thirty-four; no birth year is derived. 尚書令 is repaired.
Zhouhan died at fourteen and Zhou Jing (Luo Zhoujing) was ten; ages are not turned into birth years. The English writes 周敬 as Zhou Jing.
Units s0298-s0304 sit out of sequence in the packet and are treated as written.

Li Kuangchou's passage through Zhongshan is externally dated 895, but Chuzhi only became acting commissioner in Guanghua 3 (900). The discrepancy is noted, and the unit is not used to date Chuzhi's rule; Li Yingzhi's date is approximate.
The twenty years of secret killings is not used for dating.
晉王 here is identified externally as Li Keyong. 郁 is Wang Yu, Chuzhi's bastard son.
劉雲郎 was renamed 都 (Wang Du); both names belong to one record.
Units s0278-s0285 sit out of sequence in the packet and are treated as written.
天子 is Mingzong but is not separately recorded.
威 (Wang Wei) is Chuzhi's youngest son. Du's adoption by Chuzhi is from the earlier chunk.
鄴 is a person (Wang Ye) in s0295 and a place in s0296.
Units s0286-s0297 sit out of sequence in the packet and are treated as written.
The chapter dates Jin's defeat of Kuangchou to Qianning 1 (894); external sources give 895. The chapter date is kept and the external difference noted.
晉王 in 911 is Li Cunxu by external identification (Li Keyong died 908), so he has a separate record from the earlier Prince of Jin.
三十萬 is repaired to 300,000.
The Daoist priests are collective and are not made people.
The Prince of Jin here is Li Cunxu by external identification. 王镕 and 王處直 recur from earlier biographies.
The siege's length and the 913/914 dates for the fall and executions are external.
蒸其骨肉 is repaired to incest within the family.
The three hundred family members are collective and are not made people.
先王 is the late Prince of Jin, identified externally as Li Keyong.
